rule: Every numbered section of both review passes, plus each preamble and pass 2's closing build list and decisive test, has one row. Anchors are copied programmatically from the verbatim sources. A row is never deleted; a changed disposition is a new commit with its reason.

rows.anchor: 1. The important thing I missed previously
rows.notes: L1-L5 scales are preserved through REVIEW_LAYER_MAP; the build prompt's five layer names control the contracts. Scales, not sequential stages: one router, any layer may resolve a problem.

Layer 1 mechanisms are registered disabled (feedback control, anomaly patterning, associative microcircuit). The cortex's own gates and routing are deterministic L1-style rules: no model decides thresholds, expiry, budgets or signatures.

The cell's envelope (geometry, observations, state, memory scope, abstention, cognitive light cone, authority ceiling, failure signatures) is the CognitiveProfile. Homeostatic control, contextual bandits and active inference are reserved families; active inference must beat simpler control.
Semantic, Formal, Estimation, Evidence/Causal and the adversarial verifier run; the other solver families are reserved. The semantic organ is one replaceable organ, not a universal architect.
Decomposition, dimensional analysis, ranges, reference class, sensitivity, dependency structure. Scenario analysis is not a separate feature.
cortex.probabilistic.bayes reserved; Monte Carlo runs inside the Fermi organ; Beta-posterior updating runs in the competence ledger.

Model -> identify -> estimate -> refute, with declared identification only. DoWhy was considered and not adopted for the seed (dependency weight against 'minimal dependencies'); it is the first adoption candidate when more estimators are needed.
Every receipt separates formal validity, empirical validity and legitimate authority.

CP-SAT 0.2.0 is implemented; v0.3.0 adds cortex.optimization.continuous 0.1.0, a continuous LP organ with a duality certificate on every optimum through founder-attached formed functions. MIP and matching remain reserved.
